description: Unmodified PVB static-structure pretrained dyVAE checkpoint, direct native-step inference; no retraining.

inference.physical_time_policy: one model transition per native store interval; native ATLAS dt_100ps and MISATO dt_80ps are preserved in targets and metrics
inference.rollout_policy: frame 0 is the input; each later frame is one sequential native-step model.inference call
